metadata.question: Did Lake Menindee, Australia shrink from February 2, 2019 to May 14, 2021?

data.raw_code: The question is about whether Lake Menindee in Australia shrunk between February 2, 2019 and May 14, 2021. I need to: 1. Define the location of Lake Menindee in Australia 2. Get water extent data for both dates 3. Compare the water area to determine if it shrank For water detection, I can use Sentinel-2 imagery and the NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) to identify water pixels. I'll need to: - Get Sentinel-2 images for both dates - Calculate NDWI: (Green - NIR) / (Green + NIR) - Apply a threshold (typically > 0.0 or > 0.2) to identify water - Count water pixels for each date - Compare the counts I need to handle: - Cloud masking for Sentinel-2 - Checking if collections are empty - Validating pixel counts - Ensuring the calculation makes sense Let me structure this: 1. Define Lake Menindee geometry 2. Get Sentinel-2 collections for both dates 3. Apply cloud masking and calculate NDWI 4. Count water pixels for both periods 5. Compare and determine if shrank ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const lakeMenindee = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[142.0, -32.3], [142.4, -32.3], [142.4, -32.5], [142.0, -32.5], [142.0, -32.3]] ]); const date1 = '2019-02-02'; const date2 = '2021-05-14'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-2 function getWaterCollection(date) { return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterBounds(lakeMenindee) .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 20)); } const col1 = getWaterCollection(date1); const col2 = getWaterCollection(date2); // Check collection sizes const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2019-02-02 Images: ${size1}`); console.log(`2021-05-14 Images: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate water extent function calculateWaterArea(image) { // Calculate NDWI for water detection const ndwi = image.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B8']).rename('NDWI'); // Water mask (NDWI > 0.0) const waterMask = ndwi.gt(0.0); // Count water pixels const waterCount = waterMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: lakeMenindee, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDWI'); return waterCount; } const waterArea1 = calculateWaterArea(col1.first()); const waterArea2 = calculateWaterArea(col2.first()); const area1 = waterArea1.getInfo(); const area2 = waterArea2.getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Water Pixels: ${area1}`); console.log(`2021 Water Pixels: ${area2}`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (area1 === null || area2 === null || isNaN(area1) || isNaN(area2)) { console.log("C3"); } else if (area1 === 0 || area2 === 0) { console.log("C2"); } else if (area2 < area1) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
